decisions.reason: Although particle-therapy QA is a narrower niche and the rollout was initially constrained, management has already publicly backed this device and will likely continue to justify the investment as strategically consistent with its high-precision dosimetry franchise.
This small-volume chamber is firmly inside the firm's core measurement business, so accumulated development, certification, and customer-support commitments make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
As a multi-model product line in a central clinical category, it represents a broad and visible commitment that strongly favors continued support over abandonment.
A thimble ionization chamber is a standard offering for this type of German medical-physics supplier, and sunk costs plus installed-customer expectations support keeping it on the market.
